constructs.population: randomized participants in individually randomized RCTs
constructs.compatibility_limits: Publication-level randomized sample size; crossover period rows are not counted as independent participants.
Randomized intervention arms represented in the source metadata.
Variables explicitly assigned the Baseline covariate role in the source data dictionary.
Variable-cell missingness across source-defined baseline covariates; repeated-measures rows retain source dependence.
Variable-cell missingness across source-defined primary outcomes; not a participant attrition estimand.

constructs.population: randomized participants in RCT Bench time-to-event trials with one source-defined primary event indicator
constructs.compatibility_limits: Crude primary-event incidence, not a hazard, fixed-horizon risk, or censoring-adjusted estimand. Source variables must be binary and explicitly named as event indicators; the frozen corpus provides too few independent held-out trials for inferential concordance.

constructs.population: randomized participants in RCT Bench time-to-event trials whose primary duration variable names an explicit day, week, month, or year unit
constructs.compatibility_limits: Median observed event-or-censoring duration normalized to days. Unitless source duration variables are excluded; the frozen corpus provides too few compatible independent trials for inferential concordance.

constructs.population: randomized participants in RCT Bench trials with exactly one source-defined baseline age variable
constructs.compatibility_limits: Per-study arithmetic mean from one baseline variable matching the frozen RCT Bench age naming contract; studies with ambiguous, invariant, missing, or out-of-range age fields are excluded.

constructs.population: randomized participants in RCT Bench trials with exactly one source-defined baseline age variable
constructs.compatibility_limits: Per-study sample standard deviation from the same baseline age field used for rct_age_mean.

constructs.population: randomized participants in RCT Bench trials with exactly one source-defined baseline BMI variable
constructs.compatibility_limits: Per-study arithmetic mean from one baseline variable matching the frozen RCT Bench BMI naming contract; studies with ambiguous, invariant, missing, or out-of-range BMI fields are excluded.

constructs.population: randomized participants in RCT Bench trials with exactly one source-defined baseline BMI variable
constructs.compatibility_limits: Per-study sample standard deviation from the same baseline BMI field used for rct_bmi_mean.

constructs.population: completed randomized parallel phase 2 and phase 3 interventional studies with 2-4 arms and 20-10000 participants
constructs.compatibility_limits: Aggregate registered enrollment only; no participant-level dependence or analysis-population claim.
